name: Allow restore points more often than once per 24 hours
description: Lets Windows create a new restore point for every optimization instead of skipping requests made within 24 hours of the last one.
mechanism: Sets SystemRestorePointCreationFrequency=0 under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\SystemRestore. Windows skips a restore point if one was created within this many minutes (default 1440 when the value is absent).
benefit: Every optimization can be protected by its own verified restore point, so the app does not block changes because of throttling.
drawback: More restore points use more of the System Protection disk quota; Windows deletes the oldest points when the quota is full.
recommendedFor: Users who apply optimizations in several sessions per day.
evidence: Documented by Microsoft in the SRSetRestorePoint / CreateRestorePoint documentation. This app never changes it without an explicit request.
